name: STACK Takeoff and Estimating
summary: Cloud takeoff and estimating for many trades, with a published per-user price.
differentiator: Publishes a per-user monthly price and a cloud takeoff with symbol auto-count, but its electrical page makes no claim about an electrical database, assemblies, labor units or price feeds.
pricing: Plans listed "as low as" $299 (Takeoff & Estimate), $49 (Build & Operate) and $348 (full platform) per user per month. The pricing page does not say which plan includes electrical takeoff.

scope.takeoff: Cloud takeoff with Autocount for symbols and wire-length measurement.
scope.library: Not stated on the pages we read.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: Not stated on the pages we read.

bestFor: Teams that want cloud takeoff across several trades and will bring their own pricing.
skipIf: You want electrical assemblies and labor units supplied.
watchOut: "As low as" means the quoted figure is a starting price.
